variables.name: mId
variables.comment: * The subscription id.

variables.name: mIccId
variables.comment: * The ICCID of the SIM that is associated with this subscription, empty if unknown.

variables.name: mSimSlotIndex
variables.comment:
* The index of the SIM slot that currently contains the subscription and not necessarily
         * unique and maybe {@link SubscriptionManager#INVALID_SIM_SLOT_INDEX} if unknown or the
         * subscription is inactive.

variables.name: mDisplayName
variables.comment:
* The name displayed to the user that identifies this subscription. This name is used
         * in Settings page and can be renamed by the user.

variables.name: mCarrierName
variables.comment:
* The name displayed to the user that identifies subscription provider name. This name
         * is the SPN displayed in status bar and many other places. Can't be renamed by the user.

variables.name: mDisplayNameSource
variables.comment: * The source of the display name.

variables.name: mIconTint
variables.comment: * The color to be used for tinting the icon when displaying to the user.

variables.name: mNumber
variables.comment: * The number presented to the user identify this subscription.

variables.name: mDataRoaming
variables.comment:
* Whether user enables data roaming for this subscription or not. Either
         * {@link SubscriptionManager#DATA_ROAMING_ENABLE} or
         * {@link SubscriptionManager#DATA_ROAMING_DISABLE}.

variables.name: mMcc
variables.comment: * The mobile country code.

variables.name: mMnc
variables.comment: * The mobile network code.

variables.name: mEhplmns
variables.comment: * EHPLMNs associated with the subscription.

variables.name: mHplmns
variables.comment: * HPLMNs associated with the subscription.

variables.name: mIsEmbedded
variables.comment: * Whether the subscription is from eSIM.

variables.name: mCardString
variables.comment: * The card string of the SIM card.

variables.name: mNativeAccessRules
variables.comment:
* The native access rules for this subscription, if it is embedded and defines any. This
         * does not include access rules for non-embedded subscriptions.

variables.name: mCarrierConfigAccessRules
variables.comment:
* The carrier certificates for this subscription that are saved in carrier configs.
         * This does not include access rules from the Uicc, whether embedded or non-embedded.

variables.name: mIsRemovableEmbedded
variables.comment:
* Whether an embedded subscription is on a removable card. Such subscriptions are marked
         * inaccessible as soon as the current card is removed. Otherwise, they will remain
         * accessible unless explicitly deleted. Only meaningful when {@link #getEmbedded()} is
         * {@code 1}.

variables.name: mIsExtremeThreatAlertEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast extreme threat alert is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsSevereThreatAlertEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast severe threat alert is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsAmberAlertEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast amber alert is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsEmergencyAlertEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast emergency alert is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mAlertSoundDuration
variables.comment: * Cell broadcast alert sound duration in seconds.

variables.name: mReminderInterval
variables.comment: * Cell broadcast alert reminder interval in minutes.

variables.name: mIsAlertVibrationEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast alert vibration is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsAlertSpeechEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast alert speech is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsEtwsTestAlertEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether ETWS test alert is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsAreaInfoMessageEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether area info message is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsTestAlertEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast test alert is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsOptOutDialogEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether cell broadcast opt-out dialog should be shown or not.

variables.name: mIsEnhanced4GModeEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether enhanced 4G mode is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsVideoTelephonyEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether video telephony is enabled by the user or not.

variables.name: mIsWifiCallingEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether Wi-Fi calling is enabled by the user or not when the device is not roaming.

variables.name: mWifiCallingMode
variables.comment: * Wi-Fi calling mode when the device is not roaming.

variables.name: mWifiCallingModeForRoaming
variables.comment: * Wi-Fi calling mode when the device is roaming.

variables.name: mIsWifiCallingEnabledForRoaming
variables.comment: * Whether Wi-Fi calling is enabled by the user or not when the device is roaming.

variables.name: mIsOpportunistic
variables.comment: * Whether the subscription is opportunistic or not.

variables.name: mGroupUuid
variables.comment: * The group UUID of the subscription group in string format.

variables.name: mCountryIso
variables.comment: * The ISO Country code for the subscription's provider.

variables.name: mCarrierId
variables.comment:
* The carrier id.
         *
         * @see TelephonyManager#getSimCarrierId()

variables.name: mProfileClass
variables.comment:
* The profile class populated from the profile metadata if present. Otherwise, the profile
         * class defaults to {@link SubscriptionManager#PROFILE_CLASS_UNSET} if there is no profile
         * metadata or the subscription is not on an eUICC ({@link #getEmbedded} returns
         * {@code 0}).

variables.name: mType
variables.comment: * The subscription type.

variables.name: mGroupOwner
variables.comment: * The owner package of group the subscription belongs to.

variables.name: mEnabledMobileDataPolicies
variables.comment: * The enabled mobile data policies in string format.

variables.name: mImsi
variables.comment: * The IMSI (International Mobile Subscriber Identity) of the subscription.

variables.name: mAreUiccApplicationsEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether Uicc applications are configured to enable or not.

variables.name: mIsRcsUceEnabled
variables.comment:
* Whether the user has enabled IMS RCS User Capability Exchange (UCE) for this
         * subscription.

variables.name: mIsCrossSimCallingEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether the user has enabled cross SIM calling for this subscription.

variables.name: mRcsConfig
variables.comment: * The RCS configuration.

variables.name: mAllowedNetworkTypesForReasons
variables.comment:
* The allowed network types for reasons in string format. The format is
         * "[reason]=[network types bitmask], [reason]=[network types bitmask], ..."
         *
         * For example, "user=1239287394, thermal=298791239, carrier=3456812312".

variables.name: mDeviceToDeviceStatusSharingPreference
variables.comment: * Device to device sharing status.

variables.name: mIsVoImsOptInEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether the user has opted-in voice over IMS.

variables.name: mDeviceToDeviceStatusSharingContacts
variables.comment: * Contacts information that allow device to device sharing.

variables.name: mIsNrAdvancedCallingEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether the user has enabled NR advanced calling.

variables.name: mNumberFromCarrier
variables.comment: * The phone number retrieved from carrier.

variables.name: mNumberFromIms
variables.comment: * The phone number retrieved from IMS.

variables.name: mPortIndex
variables.comment: * the port index of the Uicc card.

variables.name: mUsageSetting
variables.comment: * Subscription's preferred usage setting.

variables.name: mLastUsedTPMessageReference
variables.comment: * Last used TP message reference.

variables.name: mUserId
variables.comment: * The user id associated with this subscription.

variables.name: mIsSatelliteEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether satellite is enabled or not.

variables.name: mIsSatelliteAttachEnabledForCarrier
variables.comment: * Whether satellite attach for carrier is enabled by user.

variables.name: mIsOnlyNonTerrestrialNetwork
variables.comment: * Whether this subscription is used for communicating with non-terrestrial network or not.

variables.name: mCardId
variables.comment: * The card ID of the SIM card which contains the subscription.

variables.name: mIsGroupDisabled
variables.comment:
* Whether group of the subscription is disabled. This is only useful if it's a grouped
         * opportunistic subscription. In this case, if all primary (non-opportunistic)
         * subscriptions in the group are deactivated (unplugged pSIM or deactivated eSIM profile),
         * we should disable this opportunistic subscription.

variables.name: mServiceCapabilities
variables.comment: * Service capabilities the subscription supports

variables.name: mTransferStatus
variables.comment: * The transfer status of the subscription

variables.name: mIsSatelliteEntitlementStatus
variables.comment: * Whether satellite entitlement status is enabled by entitlement query result.

variables.name: mSatelliteEntitlementPlmns
variables.comment: * Whether satellite entitlement plmns is empty or not by entitlement query result.
